metadata.title: Tucker Kraft finds the end zone in Week 4
metadata.description: Tucker Kraft caught six of his seven targets for 42 yards and a touchdown while adding a three-yard run in a 17-14 win over the Buccaneers in Week 4.
metadata.analysis: Kraft scored his first touchdown of the season on a two-yard pass from Jordan Love. The veteran tight end set a season-high in receptions in the game as he continues to ramp up after last season's ACL tear. Overall, Kraft has 15 catches for 148 yards and one touchdown. He will be a TE1 in fantasy in Week 5 against the Bears.

metadata.title: Tucker Kraft - Finds end zone in narrow win
metadata.description: Kraft brought in six of seven targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in the Packers' 17-14 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday. He also rushed once for three yards.
metadata.analysis: Kraft set the pace for the Packers in receptions and tied with Matthew Golden for the team lead in targets on the afternoon, while also finishing as the runner-up in receiving yards for Green Bay. The talented tight end also notched his first touchdown of the season two-yard catch early in the second half that was originally ruled out of bounds before being overturned on replay. Kraft has made a remarkable recovery from last year's season-ending knee injury, producing a 15-148-1 line over his first four games heading into a Week 5 home matchup against the Bears next Sunday.

metadata.title: Tucker Kraft Still in Search of a Return to Form
metadata.description: After opening the season with a three-catch, 65-yard performance that was good enough to make him the TE16 on the week, Green Bay Packers tight end Tucker Kraft has turned in back-to-back quiet outings, and he has fallen to TE32 for the year. After an ACL tear ended his breakout 2025 campaign, Kraft came into the season with rumblings of a pitch count, but he has shown no signs of limitation in handling a 79% snap share and ranking ninth among tight ends with 17 targets. Unfortunately, his chemistry with quarterback Jordan Love has been lacking, with the two connecting on only 52.9% of those targets. Kraft's two drops in three games are already one shy of his total from a season ago, and while his 10.8 yards after catch helped make him a dominant force in 2025, that number has fallen to 5.6 yards per catch on a limited 2026 sample. While he will need to prove he still belongs in the weekly TE1 discussion, Kraft has a plus matchup against the Buccaneers in Week 4 and is RotoBaller's TE10.

metadata.title: Tucker Kraft Underwhelms Again in Week 3 Loss
metadata.description: Green Bay Packers tight end Tucker Kraft had a quiet game in his team's 35-14 Week 3 loss to the Atlanta Falcons on Thursday, recording four catches for 26 yards on eight targets. It's been an extremely underwhelming start to the season for Kraft, who has hauled in nine catches for 106 yards on 17 targets across Green Bay's first three games of 2026. While Kraft's eight targets in Week 3 appear encouraging on the surface, Packers quarterback Jordan Love attempted 53 total passes, resulting in just a 15.1% target share for Kraft. The 25-year-old currently profiles as the clear number three option in the Green Bay passing game behind breakout wide receivers Christian Watson and Matthew Golden. Particularly if the Packers continue to operate with such a pass-heavy approach, better days should be ahead for Kraft. Still, Kraft's fantasy value is trending in the wrong direction coming out of Week 3.

metadata.title: Tucker Kraft - Modest production with four catches
metadata.description: Kraft secured four of eight targets for 26 yards in the Packers' 35-14 loss to the Falcons on Thursday. He also recovered a fumble.
metadata.analysis: Kraft finished third in targets and catches on the night for the Packers, but in uncharacteristic fashion, the field-stretching tight end was limited to a short-area role. He made an impressively rapid recovery from last year's torn ACL, which he suffered Week 9 of the 2025 campaign, to open the season in his customary No. 1 tight end role. However, he's mustered a modest a 9-106-0 line on 17 targets through three games heading into a Week 4 road matchup against the Buccaneers on Sunday, Oct. 4.

metadata.title: Tucker Kraft snags four passes in loss to Atlanta
metadata.description: Tucker Kraft caught four of eight targets for 26 yards in the Packers' 35-14 loss to Atlanta on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Kraft could have had a slightly bigger day had he held onto the football in what ended up being ruled a drop. The defensive back made a fantastic punch at the ball right as Kraft was corralling it into his chest, forcing a dropped pass. Kraft is still worth starting, and with that eight-target total, he has now beaten his season high in targets (previously six). The volume is there; the results just haven't quite followed yet.

metadata.title: Tucker Kraft Set For Bounce-Back Week 3 Against Falcons
metadata.description: Green Bay Packers tight end Tucker Kraft enters Thursday's Week 3 matchup against the Atlanta Falcons as a low-end TE1 with considerable upside. Kraft caught two of three targets for 15 yards against the Jets, but his underlying usage remained strong. He played all 50 offensive snaps and posted a 94% route participation rate after playing just 66% of the snaps in Week 1. Kraft has five catches for 80 yards through two games, and Jayden Reed (neck) has been ruled out, which should create additional opportunities alongside Christian Watson and Matthew Golden. Kraft has averaged 9.1 yards after the catch per reception since entering the league, highlighting his ability to create after the catch. Atlanta also presents a favorable matchup, having allowed 19.4 fantasy points per game to opposing tight ends, the seventh-most in the NFL, including two touchdown receptions last week. RotoBaller ranks Kraft TE9 for Week 3. Start him as a back-end TE1 with the usage and matchup to challenge for a top-six finish.

metadata.title: Packers Considering Using Tucker Kraft on The Offensive Line
metadata.description: The Green Bay Packers offensive line is in shambles early on this season, and it got worse when right tackle Zach Bako-Bewele suffered a season-ending knee injury in the Week 2 win over the New York Jets. Bako-Bewele was one of four offensive linemen for Green Bay to leave Sunday's game with an injury, and at one point, the coaches were talking about using tight end Tucker Kraft at one of the O-line positions, according to ESPN's Dan Graziano. Head coach Matt LaFleur and the rest of the coaching staff will have a hard time coming up with an O-line combination that helps their struggling running game against the Atlanta Falcons. Kraft was on his way to a career season in 2025 before suffering a season-ending torn ACL. Expectations this year were not lowered for the 25-year-old. He caught three passes for 65 yards in the season-opening loss to the division-rival Minnesota Vikings, but he followed it up with just two catches for 15 yards against the Jets. If he is forced to help the O-line and block more, it will be bad news for his fantasy football upside going into Thursday's matchup with Atlanta.

metadata.title: Tucker Kraft quiet in Week 2 win
metadata.description: Tucker Kraft caught two of his three targets for 15 yards in the Packers' 20-17 Week 2 win over the New York Jets.
metadata.analysis: Kraft was unable to make a significant impact as part of an underwhelming Green Bay passing attack, finishing with less than four receptions in each of the first two games. The tight end will look to get back on track for fantasy managers against the Atlanta Falcons in Week 3.

metadata.title: Tucker Kraft - Held to 15 yards in Week 2
metadata.description: Kraft caught two of three targets for 15 yards in Sunday's 20-17 overtime win over the Jets.
metadata.analysis: Kraft was one of five Packers to put the ball on the ground in slick conditions Sunday, but four of those fumbles were recovered by Green Bay, including Kraft's miscue. The star tight end has just five catches for 80 yards through two games in his return from a torn ACL suffered in Week 9 of last season. Prior to the injury, Kraft averaged over 60 yards per game and scored six times in eight games during the 2025 regular season. He may still be working his way back to 100 percent heading into Thursday's Week 3 home game against the struggling Falcons.

metadata.title: Tucker Kraft totals 65 yards Sunday
metadata.description: Tucker Kraft caught 3-of-6 targets for 65 yards in the Packers 39-22 loss against the Vikings.
metadata.analysis: Kraft was playing in his first game back from his torn ACL. He was on a snap count in his first game back. He remains a TE1 heading into next week against the Jets.

metadata.title: Tucker Kraft - Three catches in return
metadata.description: Kraft caught three of six targets for 65 yards in Sunday's 39-22 loss to the Vikings.
metadata.analysis: Kraft avoided the Week 1 injury report in his return from a torn ACL suffered Week 9 of last season. He finished third on the team in receiving yards in his return, behind wide receivers Christian Watson (147 yards) and Matthew Golden (95 yards). Kraft is poised to maintain a prominent role Week 2 against the Jets.

metadata.title: Tucker Kraft signs four year, $75 million deal with Packers
metadata.description: Tucker Kraft has agreed to a four-year, $75 million deal with the Green Bay Packers. The deal is worth up to $92 million.
metadata.analysis: Kraft was on his way to a massive season in 2025 before going down with a torn ACL. He gets his payday as the Packers lock in their emergeing star for the long haul.

metadata.title: Tucker Kraft - Agrees to four-year extension
metadata.description: Kraft and the Packers reached an agreement on a four-year, $75 million contract extension worth up to $92 million Saturday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
metadata.analysis: The deal includes a $26.5 million signing bonus, making Kraft the NFL's highest-paid tight end and under contract with the Packers through 2030, per Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com. Kraft was one of the most productive tight ends through the first half of the 2025 regular season before his campaign abruptly ended in Week 9 due to a torn ACL. He's not on the injury report for Sunday's regular-season opener against the Vikings, and the 2023 third-rounder is expected to be one of the top targets for Jordan Love in the passing game, alongside fellow tight end Jonnu Smith and wide receivers Christian Watson, Jayden Reed and Matthew Golden.

metadata.title: Tucker Kraft Agrees to Four-Year Extension with Packers
metadata.description: The Green Bay Packers and tight end Tucker Kraft have agreed to a contract extension, according to NFL Network's Ian Rapoport. With Kraft's rookie contract set to expire after the 2026 season, the Packers were able to lock him in for four more years, with the contract now running through 2030. Rapoport reports that Kraft will average $19.66 million over the first three years, and the overall deal is a four-year contract worth $75 million, with a maximum value of $92 million. Kraft will receive a $26.5 million signing bonus. Kraft (knee) suffered a torn ACL last November, but is not on the injury report heading into a Week 1 matchup with the Minnesota Vikings. It is unclear if Kraft will be on any kind Of pitch count. Kraft ranks as RotoBaller's No. 5 tight end for Week 1.

metadata.title: Tucker Kraft A Mid-Range TE1 Against Vikings
metadata.description: Green Bay Packers tight end Tucker Kraft looks to continue his early-season momentum from last season into Week 1 as the Packers head to Minnesota to take on the Vikings. From Week 1 through Week 8 of last season, Kraft was TE1 in fantasy points per game and had five weeks of TE10 or better in those weeks, including two overall TE1 weeks. Kraft suffered a season-ending ACL tear in Week 9 against Carolina that shut his breakout season down, but he's off the Packers' injury report and is good to go for Week 1. It's possible Kraft's workload may be a bit more managed in the season's first few weeks, but when he's on the field, he's arguably the team's most dynamic receiver and YAC threat. Kraft is a no-brainer TE1 for fantasy against the Vikings in Week 1.
